journey.name: Lift: the exercise library and exercises of your own
journey.description: Search and narrow the library from Lift, add an exercise from a search that finds nothing, change it, pick it on the Log sheet and log a set of it, then see its equipment locked. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: On the welcome, which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip to Set up", then "Skip for now" on "Set up"
Tap the "Train" tab, which opens on "Strength", then scroll to "Exercises" under "Exercises and equipment" and tap it

Verify that a page titled "Exercises" shows "Search exercises", the chips "Kettlebell", "Barbell", "Bodyweight", "Band" and "Mat", "134 exercises" and "Filters" with a chevron, a "New exercise" button in the title bar, and cards headed "Kettlebell · 30" and "Barbell · 20" (side by side on a tablet)
Type "PUSHUP" into "Search exercises"
Verify that "3 exercises" is shown with "Push-up", "Incline push-up" and "Pike push-up", in a card headed "Bodyweight · 3", each over "Reps · Upper body", and a "Clear" button
Tap "Clear"
Verify that the search is empty and "134 exercises" is shown
Tap the "Mat" chip
Verify that "47 exercises" is shown, starting with "The hundred"
Tap "Filters"
Verify that "Focus" (Upper body, Lower body, Core, Full body), "Measured by" (Reps, Time) and "Only yours" are shown
Tap "Time" under "Measured by"
Verify that "22 exercises" is shown, "Swimming" among them, "Cat-cow" and "Butterfly", and the button reads "Filters · 1"
Tap "Clear"
Verify that "134 exercises" is shown and the button reads "Filters"
Type "Copenhagen plank" into "Search exercises"
Verify that "No exercise matches “Copenhagen plank”" is shown with "Check the spelling, or clear a filter." and a button "Add “Copenhagen plank” as an exercise"
Tap "Add “Copenhagen plank” as an exercise"

Verify that a sheet opens over the library (beside it on a tablet, rising from the bottom on a phone) and shows "Copenhagen plank" in its "Name" field, "Bodyweight" and "Reps" selected, "One side at a time" off, "Full body" selected, and "Save exercise"
Tap "Time", turn on "One side at a time", tap "Core"
Type "Top knee on the bench" into the "Cues" field
Tap "Save exercise"

Verify that the library is shown, the sheet gone, still searching "Copenhagen plank", with "1 exercise": a card headed "Yours · 1" with "Copenhagen plank" over "Bodyweight · Time a side · Core" and a chevron
Tap "Copenhagen plank"

Verify that its page opens in a sheet: "Copenhagen plank" over "Bodyweight · Time a side · Core", "Cues" with "Top knee on the bench", an "Edit" button, no figure and no drawing of it from the side, and under "Your history" "Not logged yet. Its sets will show here."
Tap "Edit"
Verify that the same sheet shows "Equipment" and "Measured by" chips, and "Archive exercise"
Tap "Back" to close the sheet
Tap "New exercise" in the title bar, type "copenhagen PLANK" into the "Name" field
Verify that "One of yours already has this name." is shown and "Save exercise" is disabled
Tap "Back" to close the sheet, then "Back" to return to Train's Strength pillar
Tap "Start session", then "Add set or EMOM" in the title bar, then "Change" on the exercise card
Type "copen" into "Search exercises" and tap "Copenhagen plank"
Verify that the exercise card reads "Copenhagen plank" over "Bodyweight · Time a side · Core" with "Top knee on the bench" under it, and "Held" reads "0:30"
Tap "Log set" at the bottom of the sheet
Verify that the session shows "Copenhagen plank" with a set "0:30 · Left"
Tap "Add set or EMOM" in the title bar, then "Change" on the exercise card, then clear the search and type "Turkish sit-up"
Tap "Add “Turkish sit-up” as an exercise": the same sheet turns into the new exercise's form. Tap "Save exercise"
Verify that the sheet is back with its exercise card reading "Turkish sit-up" over "Bodyweight · Reps · Full body"
Swipe the sheet down, tap "Finish", then "Close"
Tap the "Exercises" card, type "copenhagen", tap "Copenhagen plank"
Verify that its page shows "Done 1 time · last" with today's date, "Your best" with "Longest 0:30", and a card with "0:30 · Left"; then tap "Edit"
Verify that the sheet says "Sets of it are logged, so its equipment and measure stay as they are." and shows no "Kettlebell" chip
Tap "Back" to close the sheet
Clear the search and tap "Goblet squat"
Verify that its page shows "Goblet squat" over "Kettlebell · Reps · Lower body", no "Edit" button, and "Not logged yet. Its sets will show here."

Verify that the page's first card draws the lifter from the side, with the floor, a dashed plumb line up from the ankle and the bell's dashed path, squatting and standing again and again, and that no other figure of the lift is on the page; over the drawing a tag naming the part of the rep it is in and under the tag the cue for it, changing in step: "Sit down" with "Sit between the heels, chest up", "Bottom" with "Elbows inside the knees, spine long", "Drive up" with "Knees out, push through the whole foot", "Stand tall" with "Hips through, glutes tight"; beside the tag "Step", "1×" and a pause button; and under the drawing a bar of the rep's parts, then the lift's three cues, the one the lifter is doing lit with a bar of the bell's colour and the others dim, with no "Watch for"
Tap "1×"
Verify that it reads "0.5×" and the lifter squats at half the speed; tap "0.5×" and verify that it reads "1×" again
Tap the pause button beside it
Verify that the lifter stops where it is and the button is a play button
Drag along the bar under the drawing
Verify that the lifter follows the finger down into the squat and up again, the tag, the cue under it, the lit stretch of the bar and the lit cue under the bar changing with it
Tap "Step" three times
Verify that each tap holds the lifter where the next part of the rep starts, the tag naming that part, and that after the last part it goes round to the first
Tap "Push the knees out and drive up through the whole foot"
Verify that the lifter stops at the bottom of the squat about to drive up, the tag reads "Drive up" and that cue is lit
Tap the play button
Verify that the lifter squats and stands by itself again, from where it was left
Turn the phone on its side
Verify that the cues stand beside the drawing rather than under it, the lifter still where it was and running; turn the phone upright again
Tap "Back" to close the sheet, type "swing" into "Search exercises" and tap "Two-hand swing"
Verify that under its cues the card lists "Watch for" with "Hips back, shins stay vertical", "Loosen at the top, grip on the way down" and "Knuckles to the floor, wrist straight"
Tap "Hips back, shins stay vertical"

Verify that the row is lit in red, "Done wrong" is marked over the drawing's corner and the lifter swings with its knees forward and its hips sunk, a squat rather than a hinge; tap the row again and verify that the mark goes and the hinge is right again, the rep where it was
Tap "Back" to close the sheet, type "deadlift" into "Search exercises" and tap "Deadlift"

Verify that its page has no drawing from the side with a bell's path, and its first card shows a figure holding a kettlebell: first standing still a moment bent over the bell with "Bell between your feet, hinge with a flat back" lit under "Set up", then standing up and lowering it again and again, its bell changing colour as it goes, with "Step", "Slow" and "Pause" in the card's corner; under it a bar whose short first stretch (the set-up) stands apart from the rest, with a marker moving along it in step and staying in the rep once the set-up is done; and under "Each rep" the other two cues, the one the figure is doing lit with a bar of the bell's colour and the others dim
Tap "Pause"
Verify that the figure and the marker stop where they were and the button reads "Play"
Drag the marker along the bar from left to right
Verify that the figure stands up and lowers the bell as the marker is dragged, and the lit cue changes with the bar's colour under the marker
Tap "Lower it the way it came up, hips back first"
Verify that the figure stops standing tall about to lower the bell, the marker where the bar changes colour, and that cue is lit
Tap "Bell between your feet, hinge with a flat back"
Verify that the button reads "Pause", the marker goes back to the set-up's stretch with that cue lit, and after a moment the figure lifts again, the marker carrying on into the rep
Tap "Back" to close the sheet, type "Pause goblet squat" into "Search exercises" and tap "Add “Pause goblet squat” as an exercise"
Verify that under "Figure" the row reads "No figure" with "Change" at its end
Tap "Kettlebell", type "Two seconds at the bottom" into the "Cues" field, then tap "Change" under "Figure"
Verify that a list opens under the row: "No figure", then the kettlebell lifts, each with a still of its figure
Tap "Goblet squat"
Verify that the list closes and the row reads "Goblet squat" with its figure's still; then tap "Bodyweight"
Verify that the row reads "No figure" again; tap "Kettlebell", then "Change" and "Goblet squat" again, then "Save exercise"
Tap "Pause goblet squat"

Verify that its page's first card draws the squat from the side with its bell's path, the tag and the cue for the part it is in over it and the bar of its parts under it, with none of the goblet squat's own cues in the card and no other figure; then "Cues" with "Two seconds at the bottom", and no "Watch for"
Tap "Back" to close the sheet, then "Back" to return to Train's Strength pillar
